mapper.sql: FROM acquisition_plan_asset a LEFT JOIN acquisition_plan ap ON a.acquisition_plan_id = ap.id LEFT JOIN asset_info ai ON a.asset_uid = ai.uid LEFT JOIN org_info h ON ai.hospital_uid = h.uid
mapper.select:
SELECT a.id, a.acquisition_plan_id, a.asset_uid, a.tenant_uid, a.institution_uid, a.hospital_uid, a.site_uid, a.created_by, a.created_date, a.last_modified_by, a.last_modified_date, ap.application_year AS ap_application_year, ap.application_no AS ap_application_no, ap.application_type AS ap_application_type, ai.name AS ai_name, ai.function_type AS ai_function_type, ai.clinical_dept_name AS ai_clinical_dept_name, ai.serial_num AS ai_serial_num, ai.qr_code AS ai_qr_code, ai.install_date AS ai_install_date, h.name AS ai_hospital_name
ORDER BY a.created_date DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
